# Telegram VA - Daily Briefing

## Purpose
A scheduled personal-assistant workflow that delivers a morning briefing to the owner over Telegram every day. It pulls the day's Google Calendar events, formats them into a friendly Markdown message, sends it to the configured Telegram chat, and logs a metrics row to Google Sheets. It is purely outbound and read-only against the calendar — there is no chat command handling, no AI, and no approval gate.

## How it works
- A Schedule Trigger fires once daily at 07:00 (Europe/Sarajevo) to start the run.
- "Get Today's Events" queries the assistant's Google Calendar, returning all events between the start and end of the current day, ordered by start time.
- "Format Morning Briefing" (Code node) builds a Markdown message: a "Good Morning" header with today's date, then either a "schedule is clear" note when there are no events, or a bulleted list of events showing HH:MM start time (or "All day"), title, and optional location. It also emits an event_count.
- "Send Morning Briefing" sends that message text to the configured Telegram chat with Markdown parse mode.
- "Prepare Log Data" (Code node) assembles a metrics record: ISO timestamp, trigger_type: morning, command: /briefing, action_completed: true, computed response_time_ms, and user_confirmed_before_action: n/a.
- "Log to Google Sheets" appends that record to the VA_Metrics tab of the logging spreadsheet.

## Triggered by
Schedule Trigger — daily at 07:00 Europe/Sarajevo.

## Calls (sub-workflows)
- None. There are no sub-workflow calls; the entire pipeline runs in this single workflow.

## Reads/writes
- Google Calendar (read): lists all events for the current day from the assistant's calendar, ordered by start time.
- Telegram (write): sends the briefing message to the configured chat using Markdown parse mode.
- Google Sheets (write): appends one metrics row to the VA_Metrics tab of the logging spreadsheet.
- Gmail: not used.
